description_en: Modifies user data by calling ModifyUser
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-user --display-name '张先生' --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb30000 --user-id 6f3e7751-fa61-453f-8057-a2fe97410000 --phone 18866660000 --email username@example.com --role-id example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUser

parameters.help_en: The full name of the user
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to modify.

Note that this is the unique identifier of the RAM user in the Cloud Call Center instance, not the RamId. It is a UUID
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的用户ID。


注意这里是RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识并非RamId，即UUID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the user
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en: The email address of the user
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The PhoneNumberId of the personal outbound number
parameters.name: private_outbound_number_id

parameters.help_en: The role ID to assign to the user
parameters.help_zh: 指定待创建用户的角色，需传入角色ID
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill group ID to associate with the user.

SkillGroupId.1 indicates that the user is associated with only one skill group. To associate the user with multiple skill groups, specify multiple values, such as SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, and SkillGroupId.3
parameters.help_zh:
指定待创建用户绑定的技能组ID。


SkillGroupId.1意为只绑定到一个技能组中，如果绑定多个技能组，则需要传多个，例如 SkillGroupId.1、SkillGroupId.2、SkillGroupId.3，以此类推
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill level corresponding to the skill group that the user is added to.

SkillLevel.1 indicates the skill level for SkillGroupId.1. If multiple SkillGroupId values are specified, the same number of SkillLevel values must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
待创建用户所加入的技能组对应的技能组等级。

SkillLevel.1表示为SkillGroupId.1的技能组等级，如果SkillGroupId为多个，则SkillLevel也需要多个，并且数量需要保持一致
parameters.name: skill_level

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
